explain.high_one: The dashed line follows the recent trend and the historical average. The shaded band shows the typical swing of past months: the actual figure should land inside it most of the time.
explain.high_other: The dashed line follows the recent trend and the average of the last {{count}} months. The shaded band shows how much those months typically varied: the actual figure should land inside it most of the time.
explain.medium_one: Forecast built from {{count}} month of history. The shaded band shows the typical swing; with 6 or more months the estimate gets firmer.
explain.medium_other: Forecast built from {{count}} months of history. The shaded band shows how much those months typically varied; with 6 or more months the estimate gets firmer.
explain.low_one: There is only {{count}} month of history so far. Treat these figures as a first reference: with 6 months of transactions the forecast becomes reliable.
explain.low_other: There are only {{count}} months of history so far. Treat these figures as a first reference: with 6 months of transactions the forecast becomes reliable.
